## Combined Service data and perl data and Analysis

```{r}
str(wioa_service)

colnames(wioa_service)<- c("Program","Service_code","Service_name","Date_created","Date_provide","Projected_begin","Projected_end","Last_day","Results","username","State_id","Staff","Agency_edited","Created_by","Agency_created","Method_service")

ind_wioa<- distinct(wioa_service, Program, Service_code, Date_provide, username, State_id, Staff, .keep_all = TRUE)

ind_wioa<- ind_wioa %>% filter(Program!= "Show-Me Heroes - OJT" & Program != "Skill Up St. Louis")

ind_wioa$Program<- ifelse(ind_wioa$Program=="Title I - Workforce Development (WIOA)", "WIOA","TAA")
```
